verdict.rationale: SumUp documents an official @sumup/sdk JavaScript package that wraps the SumUp API, ships TypeScript declarations, and runs on Node.js 18+, Cloudflare Workers and Vercel, with a code sample. It also offers Reader SDKs for embedding payments in Android/iOS apps and an Agent Toolkit for LangChain, AI SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK and MCP. Missing for 10: evidence of official server-side SDKs in languages beyond JavaScript, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404).
